svg.font-family: Iowan Old Style, Palatino, Georgia, serif
svg.aria-label: Two listings of one publisher's error codes
svg.text: One publisher, two listings of the same kind of thing
PostgreSQL 18.6. Every cell is one SQLSTATE. Nothing is drawn that is not in the tarball.
Appendix A of the manual — 262 codes, generated from src/backend/utils/errcodes.txt
Uniform, as the reader meets it. The six struck cells are codes that carry two macro names on two rows of the vocabulary file;
the generator emits one row per name that has a condition name, so nothing above shows that 268 rows are 262 codes.
The listing in §34.8.3 of the same manual — 21 codes, written by hand for the embedded-SQL client
in the ecpg listing only — 7 codes, none of them in Appendix A, which the same page tells the reader to consult in each case
an error in Appendix A and a warning in the ecpg listing — 4 codes
published here and nowhere in the machine — YE002, offered for 4 conditions, absent from every file of the tarball outside doc/
imposed at 10 sites, on exactly those four conditions, and in neither listing — YE000
